description: The Supreme Court - The Supreme Court rules - 2018
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the Supreme Court under Article 136 of the Constitution, amending the Supreme Court Rules 1990. The content focuses entirely on legal procedures, court rules, and regulatory frameworks for Supreme Court applications and appeals, including amendments to existing legal instruments. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with the legal framework and court procedures rather than government personnel, structure, or other specialized categories.
